summary: Practise manager routines for fair participation, employee voice and accessible teams. Explore the five-day diversity and inclusion training outline.
lede: Diversity and inclusion training helps managers and people professionals make fair participation visible in everyday team practices. Participants practise assessing team inclusion, listening and responding to employee concerns, designing inclusive meetings, reviewing everyday decisions and tracking accessibility actions using ISO 30415:2021 and GDEIB as reference points, not as compliance certification. They also use supplied sample data to build a team-level dashboard and action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who shape team routines, workforce practices or inclusion decisions and need practical ways to make fair participation visible in daily work.
prerequisites: No prior diversity and inclusion qualification is required. Familiarity with supervising or coordinating a team is useful; no coding is required.
